medium_cruiser_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Medium-cruiser variant must sit clearly between light cruiser and cruiser. Keep the silhouette as one clean contiguous hull with calmer, simpler massing than the cruiser. Longer and more deliberate than the light cruiser, but not yet a grand capital. Distinctive shield-lattice shoulders, poised line-battle proportions, and refined midline massing.

cruiser_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Cruiser variant should feel stately and line-of-battle oriented, with stronger central spine authority and more composed massing than the medium cruiser. Make it distinct from both the battlecruiser and battleship.

battlecruiser_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Battlecruiser variant must read as fast, prestigious, and elongated. Emphasize a long spearhead command profile, stretched forward rhythm, and aggressive but elegant capital-escort identity distinct from the broader battleship.

battleship_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Battleship variant must be broad, disciplined, and immensely stable. Strong armored shoulder mass, heavy line-warship authority, and more compact solidity than the battlecruiser while remaining clearly below the dreadnought and supership.

dreadnought_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Dreadnought variant should be fortress-like and monumental, with deep shield-architecture massing and heavy sacred-warship presence. Distinct from the supership by being slightly less ceremonial and more battleline brutalist within the Aegis style.

supership_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Supership variant must be the apex flagship. Make it the most majestic, most integrated, and most ceremonially advanced hull in the faction, with unmistakable flagship silhouette distinct from dreadnought and battleship.

carrier_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Carrier variant must read as a true fleet carrier rather than a line battleship or patrol hull. Broader central mass, longer internal bay channels implied through hull framing, powerful shoulder structures, heavier escort-carrier authority, and a majestic command-carrier silhouette distinct from the drone carrier.

drone_carrier_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Drone-carrier variant must be visibly different from the fleet carrier. Make it slimmer, more agile, and more support-oriented, with lighter massing, elegant lattice side volumes, compact auxiliary-bay language, and a refined tender or command-drone silhouette rather than a broad capital carrier.

transport_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Transport variant should feel protected and military-logistics focused rather than a generic combatant. Smooth cargo-bearing midbody, orderly utility framing, and escortable convoy-ship character distinct from both the hauler and drone carrier.

hauler_team_c_albedo.png.prompt_suffix: Hauler variant must be visibly broader and more burden-bearing than the transport, with elegant protected-cargo geometry, denser utility massing, and a logistics flagship feel rather than a simple freighter.
